نجتني (form VIII)
# نَجْتَنِي (najtanī) /nad͡ʒ.ta.niː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)
# نَجْتَنِيَ (najtaniya) /nad͡ʒ.ta.ni.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
